headline_marked: At least 40 dead after [[passenger bus plunges into ravine]] in Pakistan
headline: At least 40 dead after passenger bus plunges into ravine in Pakistan
summary: The vehicle was travelling from Quetta to Peshawar when it veered off the road in the mountainous Dana Sar area, leaving 11 others injured.
details: A passenger bus travelling from Quetta to Peshawar plunged approximately 70 to 80 feet into a deep ravine in the mountainous Dana Sar area of western Pakistan on Friday.
Officials have confirmed that at least 40 people were killed in the crash, while 11 others were injured.
Sanaullah Sherani, head of Zhob district's emergency centre, stated that the injured passengers were taken to the hospital, with three of them in critical condition.
Rescue teams from both Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa provinces were deployed to the scene to conduct recovery operations.
Emergency responders faced significant difficulties during the initial phase of the operation due to the rugged mountainous terrain of the accident site.
Road accidents are common in Pakistan, often attributed to weak enforcement of traffic laws, speeding, and poor road safety standards.

Rescue teams from both Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa provinces were deployed to the scene to conduct recovery operations.

Emergency responders faced significant difficulties during the initial phase of the operation due to the rugged mountainous terrain of the accident site.

headline_marked: Two childhood friends [[killed in truck-motorcycle collision]] in Gazipur
headline: Two childhood friends killed in truck-motorcycle collision in Gazipur
summary: The victims, aged 22 and 24, were traveling from Keraniganj to Mymensingh when a truck driving on the wrong side of the road hit them head-on.
details: Two men, Kawsar Ahmed (24) and Solaiman Hossain (22), were killed last night in a head-on collision between a truck and their motorcycle in Sreepur upazila of Gazipur.
The accident occurred near Shishutosh Bidyaghar in the Jaina Bazar area along the Dhaka-Mymensingh Highway, according to Maona Highway Police Station Officer-in-Charge Mohammad Kamruzzaman.
The victims, both from Keraniganj, were childhood friends who were traveling to Mymensingh to visit a friend of Solaiman's.
According to Kawsar's elder brother, the group of four friends on two motorcycles were traveling when a truck driving on the wrong side of the road collided with them.
Kawsar and Solaiman sustained severe injuries and died at the scene from excessive bleeding.
Police have recovered the bodies and taken both the truck and the motorcycle to the police station for further investigation.
caption:
Two childhood friends died on the spot after a truck driving on the wrong side of the road hit their motorcycle in Gazipur.

Two men, Kawsar Ahmed (24) and Solaiman Hossain (22), were killed last night in a head-on collision between a truck and their motorcycle in Sreepur upazila of Gazipur.

The accident occurred near Shishutosh Bidyaghar in the Jaina Bazar area along the Dhaka-Mymensingh Highway, according to Maona Highway Police Station Officer-in-Charge Mohammad Kamruzzaman.

The victims, both from Keraniganj, were childhood friends who were traveling to Mymensingh to visit a friend of Solaiman's.

According to Kawsar's elder brother, the group of four friends on two motorcycles were traveling when a truck driving on the wrong side of the road collided with them.

Kawsar and Solaiman sustained severe injuries and died at the scene from excessive bleeding.

Police have recovered the bodies and taken both the truck and the motorcycle to the police station for further investigation.
